title: WAGO: Improper Authorization and Privilege Escalation
description: Two vulnerabilities affect WAGO products CC100 and 0751-9x01. CVE-2026-80466 allows a low-privileged attacker to execute commands with root privileges, indicating improper authorization and privilege escalation. CVE-2026-88850 permits unauthorized modification of protected PROFIBUS configuration parameters by a low-privileged attacker.
